body:
The first time I smoked meth, it was a spur-of-the-moment decision. My roommate at the time had been smoking for a bit, then just asked me if I wanted to try it. Of course my fiend-ass said yes. My roommate held the torch for me, told me to twist the pipe, and to exhale as soon as I was done inhaling. She said not to hold the smoke in like you would with weed.
I loved the act of smoking it, because there was so much smoke and I barely even felt it.
Before I knew it, I was feeling more awake than ever, but not the euphoric feeling I'd read about. I spent the whole night wide awake, more talkative than ever. My roommate and I had some quality, deep conversations that night.
The only downside really was after I'd been smoking it for a few weeks, I started to feel that I was getting addicted to it. And, after being up for a few days straight, I began to pick at my skin like a full-on tweaker.
Only for occasional use.
